production.note: US model years. Kelley Blue Book (a database) lists Urus model years from 2019 (kbb-urus-years); its 2022 page lists the Urus "Sport Utility 4D" with "641 @ 6000 RPM" (kbb-urus-2022), and its 2023 page lists only the "Urus S" and "Urus Performante" (kbb-urus-2023), which are separate variants. The Drive: "2019 Lamborghini Urus" (thedrive-urus-2019).

drivetrain.note: Guide Auto: "That prodigious output is sent to all four wheels via an eight-speed automatic transmission..."

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL: named-author articles and a database, agreeing. Quote (The Drive, Chris Constantine, 4 December 2017): "650 metric horsepower (641 in U.S. and British ponies)". WhichCar (Chris Thompson, 5 December 2017): "478kW twin-turbo V8" (whichcar-urus-2018); 478 kW x 1.34102 = 641 hp. KBB (a database): "Horsepower | 641 @ 6000 RPM" for the 2019 Urus (kbb-urus-2019-specs). 650 CV x 0.98632 = 641 hp. No Lamborghini page stating the rating could be opened in this pass.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: a database plus named-author articles, all within 0.2%. Quote (iSeeCars, a database, 2019 Urus): "Curb Weight | 4844 | lbs" (2,197 kg). Guide Auto (Michel Deslauriers, 14 February 2018): "just under 2200 kilograms (4850 lbs.)" (guideautoweb-urus-2019). Autocar: "A kerb weight of 2200kg is not embarrassing" (autocar-urus). cars-data.com (a database): "2,200 kg (4,850 lb)" (carsdata-urus-2018). Lamborghini itself is quoted only with an upper limit: "Lamborghini adds that the Urus weighs less than 2200kg" (whichcar-urus-2018). It is not certain that iSeeCars' 4,844 lb is a curb rather than a dry figure.

sources.title: 2019 Lamborghini Urus Revealed, Packing 641-HP V8 and $200,000 Base Price (Chris Constantine, 4 December 2017)

provisionalNote: Power and weight are provisional. Power (641 hp = 650 CV) rests on named-author articles (The Drive, WhichCar) and KBB; a Lamborghini press release or technical sheet (lamborghini.com and media.lamborghini.com could not be read) or a major magazine panel would replace it. Weight (4,844 lb) rests on iSeeCars (a database), with Guide Auto, Autocar and cars-data.com giving 'just under' or about 2,200 kg (4,850 lb); Lamborghini states only 'less than 2200kg'. A Lamborghini curb weight, a major magazine specification panel, or failing those a Lamborghini dry weight would replace it. The end year (2022) rests on KBB.
